title: Writing --- With A Clock
label: ch:la-cum-horologio
canDo: I can complete the Latin A1 writing paper's three parts inside its published thirty minutes and meet each part's word floor.

payoff.summary: Complete LA-W03-cum-horologio: six minutes of dictation, ten of controlled sentences, fourteen for the personal note, then check each against its published range.
payoff.note: Three parts rather than two, and the per-skill floor stated plainly: each of the four papers must independently reach 15/25. Latin is the language most people meet only as reading, so the contract refuses to let reading strength stand in for the rest.
